focus_architecture.summary: device-sync.ts is a React hook module. useDeviceSync is the primary export. All per-mount state (knownEvents, invited, pendingInvites) lives in closure of runKeyPackageSync (one instance per mount).

key_data_structures.knownEvents: Map<string, NostrEvent> keyed by event id; closure-scoped to runKeyPackageSync; never persisted; only grows (no delete)
key_data_structures.invited: Set<string> pre-seeded from IDB (loadInvitedKeys); dedup key = group.idStr:slot; survives across mounts via IDB
key_data_structures.pendingInvites: Set<string> in-memory only; in-flight dedup guard; reset per mount

triggers_for_syncKnownKeyPackages: initial bulk fetch of KP events resolves (device-sync.ts:1304)
focus_architecture.joinBarrier: Promise<void>|null manual barrier that syncKnownKeyPackages awaits to prevent duplicate-invite cascade from synchronous groupsUpdated emitted inside joinGroupFromWelcome
focus_architecture.module_scope_state: Three Maps survive across mounts: expectedPublishByHTag, dispatchPublishInFlightByHTag, windowKind445State (all for publish-window tracking, not KP sync)

focus_testing_and_conventions.summary: e2e test for the exact fix already exists and passes. Sibling tests use same E2E_BUNKER_URL for both contexts with distinct explicit slot strings. Timeout: 240000ms for sibling tests.
